summary.plain: The BESIII detector: a layered cylinder around the collision point with a helium drift chamber, scintillator timing counters, a crystal calorimeter and muon counters inside a 1-tesla superconducting magnet, covering 93% of all directions.
summary.technical: BESIII: helium-based multilayer drift chamber (MDC), plastic-scintillator TOF, CsI(Tl) electromagnetic calorimeter, all inside a superconducting solenoid (1.0 T; 0.9 T in 2012), octagonal steel flux-return yoke with resistive plate counter muon modules; 93% acceptance over 4π; momentum resolution 0.5% at 1 GeV/c; end-cap TOF upgraded in 2015 with MRPCs.

technology.quote: consists of a helium-based multilayer drift chamber (MDC), a plastic scintillator time-of-flight system (TOF), and a CsI(Tl) electromagnetic calorimeter (EMC), which are all enclosed in a superconducting solenoidal magnet
technology.value: Helium-based multilayer drift chamber, plastic-scintillator TOF and CsI(Tl) electromagnetic calorimeter inside a 1.0 T superconducting solenoid, with resistive-plate-chamber muon identifier
